# teams_resource_account_association (Resource)

Associates a Teams resource account with an auto attendant or call queue via New-CsOnlineApplicationInstanceAssociation / Get-CsOnlineApplicationInstanceAssociation / Remove-CsOnlineApplicationInstanceAssociation. Any change requires replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teams_resource_account" "support" {
  user_principal_name = "ra-support@contoso.com"
  display_name        = "Support line"
  type                = "call_queue"
}

resource "teams_call_queue" "support" {
  name = "Support"
}

resource "teams_resource_account_association" "support" {
  resource_account_id = teams_resource_account.support.id
  configuration_id    = teams_call_queue.support.id
  configuration_type  = "call_queue"
  call_priority       = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration_id` (String) Id of the auto attendant or call queue.
- `configuration_type` (String) Type of the configuration: auto_attendant or call_queue.
- `resource_account_id` (String) Object id of the resource account.

### Optional

- `call_priority` (Number) Priority of calls through this resource account (1-5, 1 is highest).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object id of the resource account.
